title: beta-elemene Suppresses Migration of Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma by Modulating Expression of MMP9 through the PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB Pathway.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究β-榄香烯通过PI3K/Akt/NF-κB通路抑制食管鳞癌迁移，涉及MMP9表达调控，但核心是药物机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，仅含分子对接且非TF-DNA体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: beta-elemene is a plant-derived drug with broad-spectrum anticancer activity. Studies have found that beta-elemene can inhibit tumor cell proliferation, induce tumor cell apoptosis, and resist tumor cell migration and invasion. Esophageal cancer is a common digestive tract malignant tumor. Progress has been made in the treatment of esophageal cancer, including the use of beta-elemene, but the mechanism of anti-migration is unclear. PI3K/Akt/NF- kappaB/MMP9 signaling pathway is involved in the regulation of tumor cell proliferation, migration, extracellular matrix(ECM), and basement membrane(BM) degradation. This study aims to investigate the effect of beta-elemene on the migration of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) and its related mechanisms by bioinformatics, network pharmacology, and molecular docking methods. METHODS: In this study, the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) of ESCC were screened through GeneCards and BATMAN-TCM databases combined with the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database (GSE17351). Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway analyses were performed to identify the functions and related pathways of the genes. The protein-protein interaction (PPI) network of these DEGs was constructed with the STRING database. Five hub genes were screened by CytoHubba plug-in Cytoscape according to the principle of degree value and the expressions of which were validated by the UALCAN database from the Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). The hub gene with the strongest binding energy was identified by molecular docking. A wound healing assay was subjected to assess the migration ability. RT-PCR was used to detect the content of migration-related mRNA. Western blotting was performed to examine the expression rates of Akt, NF-kappaB, and MMP9 in ESCC tissues by beta-elemene and SC79. RESULTS: 71 target genes were obtained which were mainly involved in biological processes such as epidermal development and extracellular matrix decomposition. In addition, critical pathways, including PI3K/AKT signaling pathway and focal adhesion, were verified to be subject to beta-elemene regulation. It exhibited marked binding affinity between beta-elemene and MMP9 with an excellent docking score of -6.56 kcal/mol. The expression levels of Akt, NF-kappaB, and MMP9 in ESCC tissues were significantly upregulated compared to normal tissues. Western blot detection demonstrated that beta-elemene specifically reduced the phosphorylation level of Akt, and its downstream target molecule NF-kappaB, thus resulting in reduced levels of their target proteins, including MMP9 in ESCC. A wound healing assay showed beta-elemene inhibited the migration of ESCC cells. RT-PCR results found that the mRNA expression of Akt, NF-kappaB, and MMP9 in the beta-elemene group was significantly lower than that in the control group. However, the application of SC79 partially reversed the effect of beta-elemene. CONCLUSION: In summary, our study suggests that the anti-tumor migration effect of beta-elemene on ESCC is associated with the inhibition of PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB/MMP9 signalling pathway, and it provides a theoretical reference for further rational clinical application.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：β-榄香烯是一种植物来源的药物，具有广谱抗肿瘤活性。研究发现，β-榄香烯能抑制肿瘤细胞增殖、诱导肿瘤细胞凋亡，并抵抗肿瘤细胞迁移和侵袭。食管癌是一种常见的消化道恶性肿瘤。食管癌的治疗已取得进展，包括使用β-榄香烯，但其抗迁移机制尚不清楚。PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB/MMP9信号通路参与调控肿瘤细胞增殖、迁移、细胞外基质（ECM）和基底膜（BM）降解。本研究旨在通过生物信息学、网络药理学和分子对接方法，探讨β-榄香烯对食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）迁移的影响及其相关机制。方法：本研究通过GeneCards和BATMAN-TCM数据库，结合基因表达综合（GEO）数据库（GSE17351），筛选ESCC的差异表达基因（DEGs）。进行基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路分析，以确定基因的功能和相关通路。利用STRING数据库构建这些DEGs的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。根据度值原则，通过CytoHubba插件Cytoscape筛选出五个核心基因，并使用癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）中的UALCAN数据库验证其表达。通过分子对接确定结合能最强的核心基因。采用伤口愈合实验评估迁移能力。使用RT-PCR检测迁移相关mRNA的含量。通过Western blotting检测β-榄香烯和SC79对ESCC组织中Akt、NF-kappaB和MMP9表达率的影响。结果：共获得71个靶基因，主要涉及表皮发育和细胞外基质分解等生物过程。此外，关键通路，包括PI3K/AKT信号通路和黏着斑，被验证受β-榄香烯调控。β-榄香烯与MMP9之间表现出显著的结合亲和力，对接分数为-6.56 kcal/mol。与正常组织相比，ESCC组织中Akt、NF-kappaB和MMP9的表达水平显著上调。Western blot检测表明，β-榄香烯特异性降低Akt及其下游靶分子NF-kappaB的磷酸化水平，从而导致其靶蛋白（包括ESCC中的MMP9）水平降低。伤口愈合实验显示，β-榄香烯抑制ESCC细胞的迁移。RT-PCR结果发现，β-榄香烯组中Akt、NF-kappaB和MMP9的mRNA表达显著低于对照组。然而，SC79的应用部分逆转了β-榄香烯的作用。结论：总之，我们的研究表明，β-榄香烯对ESCC的抗肿瘤迁移作用与抑制PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB/MMP9信号通路相关，这为进一步合理的临床应用提供了理论参考。
